delta.description: public surface for the local AEG workspace: (1) public anchor feed aeg/feed-v0 on mountain/adva carrying all 22 receipts byte-exact with pins, chain, three declared repairs and one declared disclosure exception, plus a self-contained checker (FeedConsistent); (2) mechanical projector project_receipt.py (receipt pair -> bounded-exchange response with byte-level witness: receipt pins, JSON pointers, verbatim excerpts, feed paths); (3) disclosure preflight disclose_preflight.py (byte budget, private-path patterns, field bounds, request binding) - ClearToSend on round-04 regression.

documented_holes: the projector's deterministic mapping (task/result/residual) is a declared projection rule, not semantic extraction; the other side cannot verify intent, only byte equality
the feed is a snapshot per build; no append-only publication timeline yet (exchange ledger = next block)
the preflight scanner is pattern-based: non-path secrets (e.g. a bare API key) would not be caught by path patterns
receipt-20's /Users/mingli mention remains the single declared exception; any deeper path disclosure is still blocked
no_claims: no claim the feed authenticates provenance: pins bind bytes, not authorship
no claim semantic acceptance becomes automatic: source-to-projection verification still needs the receiver to run the checker against the feed bytes
source materials (PDFs, text layers, trial scripts) remain local and are not in the feed
